title: Second colony to Origo (Carthage)
summary: A second wave of settlers goes to Carthage, 133 or 143 years after the capture of Troy.
description: A second wave of settlers goes to Carthage, 133 or 143 years after the capture of Troy. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 3 (Table 2, row “1050, 1040”, p. 46).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 3): 1050, 1040 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 3: The Founding Dates of Tyre and Carthage," OSF preprint v1.2 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9V65S, Table 2, row “1050, 1040”, p. 46
chronologies.note: Second colony to Origo, 133 or 143 years after the Fall of Troy (Syncellus, Eusebius). Printed as two alternatives; the year stored is 1050.
